turns.question: How do I speak at a city council meeting?
turns.answer:
To speak at a city council meeting, you need to sign up during the designated public comment period. [1] Members of the public wishing to speak must provide their name and the topic they wish to discuss. [1] During the public comment period, the mayor or chair may allot each speaker a maximum amount of time to present their comments, subject to extension by the mayor or by a majority vote of the council. [1]

In general, city council meetings include a period for public comment, allowing residents to share their views on agenda items. In Vineyard, the rules for public comment are outlined in the Municipal Code, which requires a designated period for public comment at every regular City Council meeting that includes a business item.
